scenarios.title: Normal operation
scenarios.pass_condition: Every command of the pick-and-place path is ALLOW; telemetry shows the arm reaching every waypoint while it pauses there; no deadline miss: no lease expiry, no guardian-to-arm send fault, the lease valid whenever the arm moves, and no telemetry interval of 2 control periods or more (strict on the Pi 5; on QEMU measured and reported, not judged, because QEMU proves function, never timing); and the independent checks find no limit, keep-out or speed violation.
